newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BRL Hardy joins with French winemaker.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BRL Hardy joins with French winemaker.

text.p: Winemaker BRL Hardy Ltd said on Friday it had introduced a French partner into the company's French winery Domaine de la Baume.

BRL managing director Stephen Millar said the L'Occitane winery group based in the Midi region had acquired an initial equity interest of 10 percent in La Baume SA, BRL's French holding company, as part of a long term strategic alliance.
The purchase price was 2.5 million French francs, a BRL spokesman said.

"The concept behind admitting a minority local partner is to gain access to locally made wines made to BRL quality standards without the substantial capital expenditure and to become an integral part of the local industry," Millar told a Securities Institute of Australia luncheon.
BRL Hardy's French operation was established in 1990 at the Domaine de la Baume winery near Beziers in the Languedoc Roussillon region of the Midi.

"BRL Hardy is able to provide L'Occitane with access to international markets and Australian winemaking expertise, while L'Occitane will assist La Baume to build its influence in the region and will provide some additional access to the wine La Baume will require in future years to satisfy its growing markets," he said.
